PLAN "PCOS Strength & Insulin Sensitivity - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity via resistance training"
  GOAL secondary body_composition:
    name "Build lean mass and improve body composition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
